correctness.rationale: In \(T_{\mathrm{AS}}\), every nonzero distance lies in \([1/2,1]\), so all triangle inequalities among free nonzero distances are automatic. After fixing equalities and identifications with named parameters, the only free atomic data are the \(mk\) distances from new classes to parameters and the \(\binom{k}{2}\) distances among new classes; every coordinate tuple is a consistent finite extension, and quantifier elimination makes it a complete type. Compact-to-Hausdorff gives the cube homeomorphism. Inclusion--exclusion/Stirling counting yields the component formulas and the maximal dimension occurs at \(k=n\). The inspected verifier independently enumerates all patterns for \(m\le3,n\le6\).
